title: Bug Too!
overview:
Leaner Meaner Greener

Faster than a cockroach in a New York deli, the world's juiciest action hero returns with a totally unstompable sequel - and two of the most outrageous co-stars to infest a game screen.

Play as lightning-tongue Maggot Dog or Dr. Funk himself, Superfly. Squash Sandanistan Worms, Amazon Ant Women and Saturn-Headed Space Vampires until you're blue (or green) in the face.

Bug is back and it's Boo-Ya time all over again!

- Bug-dacious 2 player mode!
- Special CD quality music & sound effects!
- Play as Maggot Dog, a half-breed with a sticky tongue and ears that fly him like a helicopter.
- Play as Superfly, the hippest, downist, larvae this side of the neighbor's hedge.

Unstompable
